intro: At Stormwind Gate, sentries watch the road between Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City. The passage opens onto the Valley of Heroes, where the city’s stone monuments rise beyond the arch.

p: Stormwind Gate guards the southern road from Elwynn Forest into the capital. The Stormwind City Guard watches from the stone portal, while patrols move between the outer arch and the Valley of Heroes. Unrest lingers in Elwynn, yet the massive iron and stone gates stay open. Travelers, merchants, and returning defenders pass through into the heart of the Alliance.
